protocol.prep_gate: Exact native FP8 Q and entire post-store K/V bytes for both input versions of all six cases before any complete-call timing
protocol.timed_region: Entire kernel_fn CUDA graph device work: preparation, cache stores, FA3 scheduling/compute/combine and output gate; graph memory reused on replay, host allocation excluded
protocol.excludes: Fixture/scheduler-metadata creation, cache/input restore, L2 eviction, validation, empty-graph diagnostic
protocol.concurrency: Two independent graph captures with private default allocation pools, concurrently submitted on separate streams for each boundary target; no claim of actual hardware overlap
